claim: T_DET: for all M:N, over any CommRing R, det (Amat w lam M) = cseq w lam M, where Amat is the verbatim tridiagonal matrix (diagonal 1, super-diagonal (i,i+1)=lam*w(i+2), sub-diagonal (i+1,i)=-1) and cseq is the continuant c0=1, c1=1, c(n+2)=c(n+1)+lam*w(n+2)*c n. Proved by back-peel cofactor expansion (det_succ_row/column) establishing the determinant recurrence Amat_det_rec, then strong induction.

T_COMB: for all M:N, over any CommRing R, cseq w lam M = Rpoly w lam M, where Rpoly w lam M = sum over sparse (no two consecutive) subsets S of Icc 2 M of prod_{i in S} lam*w i (weighted independence polynomial of the path on {2..M}). Proved in full general M (NOT finite fallback) by showing Rpoly satisfies recurrence REC via deletion-contraction on the top vertex M (Sp_succ_not, Sp_succ_mem, insert_injOn_Sp, Rpoly_rec), then induction.

Amat_det_rec (P1 crux): det (Amat w lam (M+2)) = det (Amat w lam (M+1)) + lam*w(M+2)*det (Amat w lam M). Cofactor expansion along the last row (det_succ_row at Fin.last), sum_univ_castSucc split, sum_eq_single collapse to the surviving sub-diagonal -1 entry; sign bookkeeping (-1)^{2M+1}=-1 cancels the -1. Sub-block dets via Amat_submatrix_castSucc and Amat_inner_det.

Amat_inner_det: det of the sub-diagonal cofactor block (delete last row and second-to-last column of Amat (M+2)) = lam*w(M+2)*det (Amat w lam M). Last-column cofactor expansion (det_succ_column) with sum_eq_single collapsing to the surviving -1 corner, sign (-1)^{2M}=1, doubly-inner block = Amat M (Amat_inner_submatrix).

Rpoly_rec (P2 crux): Rpoly w lam (n+2) = Rpoly w lam (n+1) + lam*w(n+2)*Rpoly w lam n. Deletion-contraction: split the sparse-subset sum on membership of top vertex n+2 (sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not); the non-members are exactly Sp(n+1) (Sp_succ_not), the members biject with Sp(n) via insert (n+2) (Sp_succ_mem, sum_image with insert_injOn_Sp) contributing factor lam*w(n+2) (prod_insert).

G0 falsification: the brief's stated base case c1=1+lam*w1 is WRONG for the verbatim matrix. g0_det_one proves det (Amat w lam 1)=1; g0_brief_base_is_wrong exhibits w=1,lam=1 over Z with det=1 != 2 = 1+lam*w1. Corrected convention c1=1 is locked and used throughout; cseq M is the independence polynomial of the path on {2..M}.
